name: 20105 · Aldie, VA
findings: ZIP 20105 (Aldie) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20105 (Aldie) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 20105 (Aldie) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
